facts.fact: UCC and Starlink signed a memorandum of understanding and an operational licence agreement in May 2026, per Space in Africa.

Roke Telkom and Paratus Uganda launched Starlink for Business in Uganda, with Paratus Uganda the first provider to offer Starlink commercially, on 24-month plans of 500GB to 2TB at 40-220 Mbps down, per Space in Africa.
